title: Irregular futures
goal: Use the most common irregular futures (je serai, j'aurai, j'irai, je ferai, je pourrai…) and say what you will do when something happens, with quand + futur.

items.fr: je serai, j'aurai, j'irai, je ferai
items.en: irregular futures: être, avoir, aller, faire

drills.en: In two weeks, I will be Canadian.
We will have a Canadian passport.
This summer, they will go to Morocco.

drills.prompt: I will do my homework tonight.
accept: Je ferai mes devoirs ce soir.
Ce soir, je ferai mes devoirs.

items.fr: je pourrai, je voudrai, je devrai, je viendrai, je verrai, je saurai, il faudra
items.en: irregular futures: pouvoir, vouloir, devoir, venir, voir, savoir, falloir

drills.en: After the ceremony, you will be able to vote.
You will have to arrive 30 minutes early.

options: Il faudra apporter deux pièces d'identité.

Il fallera apporter deux pièces d'identité.
drills.explain: falloir → il faudra. It only exists with il.

items.fr: Quand je serai citoyenne, je voterai.
items.en: quand + futur (English uses the present after “when”)

drills.text: Quand j'___ mon passeport, j'irai voir ma famille. (avoir)
drills.en: When I have my passport, I'll go see my family.
drills.explain: The action is in the future, so French uses the future after quand: j'aurai.

options: Quand je serai citoyen, je voterai.
Quand je suis citoyen, je voterai.
drills.explain: English says “when I am”, but French uses the future: quand je serai.

example.fr: Je voterai pour la première fois.
example.en: I will vote for the first time.

items.note: Vous prêterez serment = you will take the oath.

items.fr: Il faudra apporter une pièce d'identité.
items.en: We'll have to bring a piece of ID. (it will be necessary)

blocks.title: Information sheet from a newcomers' centre
blocks.context: Amira's community centre gives this sheet to people who are invited to a citizenship ceremony.
blocks.fr:
Votre cérémonie de citoyenneté
- Vous devrez arriver 30 minutes avant le début de la cérémonie.
- Il faudra apporter votre lettre d'invitation et deux pièces d'identité.
- Votre famille et vos amis pourront venir avec vous.
- Vous prêterez serment et vous chanterez l'hymne national.
- Après la cérémonie, vous serez citoyen canadien ou citoyenne canadienne, et vous aurez votre certificat de citoyenneté.
Attention : les règles peuvent changer. Lisez bien votre lettre d'invitation.
blocks.en:
Your citizenship ceremony
- You will have to arrive 30 minutes before the start of the ceremony.
- You will need to bring your invitation letter and two pieces of ID.
- Your family and friends will be able to come with you.
- You will take the oath and you will sing the national anthem.
- After the ceremony, you will be a Canadian citizen, and you will have your citizenship certificate.
Note: rules can change. Read your invitation letter carefully.

lines.fr: Alors, c'est bientôt le grand jour ?
lines.en: So, the big day is coming soon?

lines.fr: Oui, dans deux semaines ! Je serai enfin canadienne.
lines.en: Yes, in two weeks! I'll finally be Canadian.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Et qu'est-ce que tu feras après ?
lines.en: And what will you do afterwards?

lines.en: When I have my passport, I'll go to Morocco to see my family. It's been three years!

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.en: And you'll be able to vote!

lines.speaker: Amira
lines.fr: Oui ! Aux prochaines élections, je voterai pour la première fois. Tu viendras à la cérémonie ?
lines.en: Yes! In the next election, I'll vote for the first time. Will you come to the ceremony?

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Bien sûr, je viendrai ! Il faudra prendre beaucoup de photos.
lines.en: Of course I'll come! We'll have to take lots of pictures.

lines.speaker: Amira
lines.fr: Tu verras, ce sera très émouvant.

lines.en: And will you know how to sing “O Canada” in French?

lines.speaker: Amira
lines.fr: J'apprends les paroles en ce moment. Le jour de la cérémonie, je saurai tout par cœur !

blocks.title: Same endings, new stems
blocks.body: About a dozen common verbs have an **irregular stem** in the future. The good news: the **endings never change** ([[-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont]]), and every stem still ends in **r**. Learn the stems as a list, and you can use all six persons right away.

blocks.title: The key irregular stems
head: infinitive
stem
je / j'
example
rows: Il faudra apporter deux pièces d'identité.
blocks.note: Two r's in [[pourr-]] and [[verr-]]. [[Il faudra]] only exists with **il**: it means *it will be necessary, we'll have to*.

blocks.title: All persons: être and aller
head: être
aller
blocks.note: [[Ce sera]] = it will be: [[Ce sera très émouvant.]] It is the future of [[c'est]] (and [[c'était]] in the past).

blocks.title: Quand + futur
blocks.note: When both actions are in the future, French uses the **future in both parts**. English uses the present after *when*, so this is a classic trap.

examples.fr: Quand je serai citoyenne, je voterai.
examples.en: When I'm a citizen, I'll vote.

examples.fr: Quand j'aurai mon passeport, j'irai au Maroc.
examples.en: When I have my passport, I'll go to Morocco.

examples.fr: Quand tu viendras à Montréal, on ira au marché.
examples.en: When you come to Montréal, we'll go to the market.

blocks.title: Why the future after quand?
blocks.body:
French is logical here: if the action **will** happen, it is in the future, whatever word comes before it. [[Quand je serai citoyenne]] is literally *when I will be a citizen*. The same goes for [[lorsque]] (a more formal *when*) and [[dès que]] (as soon as): [[Dès que j'aurai mon passeport, je réserverai mon billet.]]

But with [[si]] (if), French uses the **present**, like English: [[Si je réussis, je serai content.]]

examples.fr: Si tu veux, tu viendras avec moi.
examples.en: If you want, you'll come with me.

blocks.body:
- **Present after quand:** [[Quand je suis citoyenne, je voterai]] → [[Quand je serai citoyenne, je voterai]].
- **One r instead of two:** [[je pourai]] → [[je pourrai]]; [[je verai]] → [[je verrai]].
- **Regular stem for aller:** [[j'allerai]] → [[j'irai]].
- **Serai or saurai?** [[je serai]] = I will be (être); [[je saurai]] = I will know (savoir).
- **Il faudra with a person:** [[je faudrai]] doesn't exist. Say [[je devrai]] (I'll have to) or [[il faudra]].
- **Ferai** is pronounced *fe-ré*, like the first syllable of [[faisait]], not *fai-ré*.

blocks.title: Citizenship ceremonies
blocks.body:
At a citizenship ceremony, new citizens take the **oath of citizenship** ([[prêter serment]]), in English or French, and receive proof of citizenship. Family and friends can often attend. Procedures change (some ceremonies are online), so always follow your invitation letter and the official IRCC website.

Fun fact: the French lyrics of [[Ô Canada]] are **not a translation** of the English ones. They were written first, in 1880, by Adolphe-Basile Routhier (music by Calixa Lavallée), and the English words, written later, say quite different things.

lines.fr: Quand j'aurai mon passeport, j'irai au Maroc.
lines.en: When I have my passport, I'll go to Morocco.

lines.tip: pourras: the double r is said as one r, pou-ra.

lines.fr: Tu verras, ce sera très émouvant.

blocks.fr: Quand je serai à Toronto, je verrai mon frère.
blocks.en: When I'm in Toronto, I'll see my brother.
blocks.prompt: What will the speaker do in Toronto?
blocks.explain: [[je verrai]] = I will see (voir). [[Je saurai]] would be I will know.

blocks.fr: Il faudra arriver une demi-heure avant.
blocks.en: You'll have to arrive half an hour early.
blocks.explain: [[Il faudra]] = it will be necessary. [[avant]] = before, early.

blocks.text: L'année prochaine, nous ___ en vacances au Vietnam. (aller)
blocks.en: Next year, we will go on vacation to Vietnam.

blocks.prompt: Match each infinitive with its future stem.

blocks.en: When you come to Ottawa, we'll visit Parliament.

blocks.prompt: “When I have time, I'll go to the movies.” Which is correct?
options: Quand j'aurai le temps, j'irai au cinéma.
Quand j'ai le temps, j'irai au cinéma.
Quand j'avais le temps, j'irai au cinéma.
optionFeedback: English uses the present, but French needs the future after quand: j'aurai.
j'avais is the imparfait, a past tense.

blocks.prompt: I will be able to vote for the first time.
accept: Je pourrai voter pour la première fois.
Pour la première fois, je pourrai voter.

blocks.en: You will have to bring your invitation letter.
blocks.explain: devoir → devr- + -ez. [[devez]] is the present, [[deviez]] the imparfait.

blocks.prompt: When I'm a citizen, I'll have a Canadian passport. (woman speaking)
accept: Quand je serai citoyenne, j'aurai un passeport canadien.
Quand je serai canadienne, j'aurai un passeport canadien.
J'aurai un passeport canadien quand je serai citoyenne.
Lorsque je serai citoyenne, j'aurai un passeport canadien.
Quand je serai citoyenne canadienne, j'aurai un passeport canadien.
blocks.explain: Future in both parts: [[quand je serai]], [[j'aurai]].
[[ce sera]] = future of [[c'est]]. [[C'était]] is the past.

blocks.text: Quand j'étais petite, je ___ devenir chanteuse. Bientôt, je ___ chanter l'hymne national ! (vouloir, savoir)
blocks.en: When I was little, I wanted to become a singer. Soon I'll know how to sing the national anthem!
blocks.explain: A past wish → imparfait ([[je voulais]], unit 3). A future ability → [[je saurai]] (savoir → saur-).

blocks.fr: Il faudra apporter deux pièces d'identité.
blocks.explain: [[il faudra]] = we'll have to / it will be necessary. [[Une pièce d'identité]] = a piece of ID.

blocks.prompt: Imagine a big step in your future in Canada (citizenship, a diploma, a new job, buying a home). Write what you will do when it happens. Use quand + futur at least twice.
checklist: At least four different irregular stems: serai, aurai, irai, ferai, pourrai…
Il faudra… for something you'll have to do
One feeling: je serai content / contente, fier / fière

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Quand je serai citoyen, je serai très fier. Il faudra fêter ça ! Je ferai une grande fête avec mes amis. Quand j'aurai mon passeport, j'irai en Inde avec mes enfants : ils verront la maison de mes parents. Et quand il y aura des élections, je pourrai voter pour la première fois.
models.en: When I'm a citizen, I'll be very proud. We'll have to celebrate! I'll throw a big party with my friends. When I have my passport, I'll go to India with my children: they'll see my parents' house. And when there's an election, I'll be able to vote for the first time.

blocks.prompt: A friend is nervous about their citizenship ceremony. Reassure them in about 30 seconds: say what will happen, what they will have to bring, and how they will feel.
checklist: Quand tu seras citoyen / citoyenne, tu…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Tu verras, ce sera très facile ! Il faudra arriver un peu avant et apporter ta lettre. Tu prêteras serment et tu chanteras « Ô Canada ». Ta famille pourra venir avec toi. Et quand tu seras citoyenne, on fera une fête !
models.en: You'll see, it'll be very easy! You'll need to arrive a little early and bring your letter. You'll take the oath and sing “O Canada”. Your family will be able to come with you. And when you're a citizen, we'll throw a party!

summary:
- Use the key irregular futures: [[je serai, j'aurai, j'irai, je ferai, je pourrai, je voudrai, je devrai, je viendrai, je verrai, je saurai, il faudra]]
- Remember the endings never change, and every stem ends in **r**
- Use the future after **quand**: [[Quand je serai citoyenne, je voterai.]]
